html:
The Potala Palace is the great palace and monastery of the Dalai Lamas, built on the Red Hill above Lhasa. It was their winter home from 1649 to 1959.

Tradition says the Tibetan king Songtsen Gampo of the Tibetan Empire had a palace on the hill in the 600s. The 5th Dalai Lama began the present building in 1645, soon after he became ruler of Tibet. The White Palace, with living quarters and offices, came first. The Red Palace in the middle, with halls, chapels and the gold covered tombs of Dalai Lamas, was finished in 1694 under the regent Desi Sangye Gyatso.

Its name comes from Potalaka, the mountain home of the bodhisattva of compassion, of whom the Dalai Lamas are held to be incarnations. It housed the Tibetan government as well as the Dalai Lama. Since the 14th Dalai Lama fled in 1959 it has been a museum.
sum: The Potala Palace is the great palace and monastery of the Dalai Lamas, built on the Red Hill above Lhasa. It was their winter home from 1649 to 1959.
